The festival

Hilltop, Vagator. The home of Goa trance.

Hilltop is Goa's legendary psytrance venue in Vagator, North Goa, the neighbourhood where the Goa trance scene was born. Giant painted canopies, open skies and a crowd that comes back every year.

Once a year it hosts Hilltop Festival, the weekend Goa's psy crowd waits for. The 2027 edition is the 16th, and the first to run over two weekends. We're going for Weekend 2: four days, 4 to 7 February.

We are independent hosts, not the festival organisers. We buy your Weekend 2 pass through the official ticket seller and handle everything around it. The festival announces its own line-up.

16th editionWeekend 2 4–7 FebVagator North Goa
Day by day · 4–9 Feb

Six days, one rhythm.

Thu4 Feb Arrive + Hilltop opens Airport pickup, check-in at the villa, lunch by the pool. The festival opens today, and our cars take you up whenever you are ready. Day 1
Fri5 Feb Pool, then Hilltop Sleep in, breakfast by the pool, then Hilltop. Back at the villa, the after-party carries on. Day 2
Sat6 Feb The big night A crew shoot with our photographer in the afternoon, then Hilltop's biggest night of the weekend. Peak
Sun7 Feb Closing day Hilltop's final day. Sunset, one last set, then a late dinner together at the villa. Day 4
Mon8 Feb The Mooncrew house party Our own party at the villa: booked DJs, the pool, food all day and a Goa sunset to close the festival. House party
Tue9 Feb Slow goodbye Breakfast, one last swim, check-out and your airport drop. Home

Festival timings follow the official schedule. Outdoor music at the villa ends at 10 pm, as Goa's rules require.

New to raves?

Never raved before? Start here.

A lot of people want to go to a rave but don't know how. That's exactly who we built this trip for.

01

Never raved before? Good.

Most of our crew were first-timers once. We walk you through everything before the trip, and we are with you on the dancefloor.

02

Wear what you can dance in

Light clothes, comfortable shoes, a layer for later at night, sunglasses for the afternoon.

03

Water and earplugs

Drink water through the day and take breaks. Musician earplugs keep the music clear and your ears safe.

04

Stay with your crew

We move together, share live locations and ride back together. Nobody gets left behind.

05

No drugs. You won’t need them.

We run drug-free trips. The music, the people and a sunset at Hilltop do the job.

06

Rest is part of the plan

Pool afternoons, naps and good food between the big nights, so you enjoy every day.

Our promise

Wild nights. Safe hands.

  • One of your hosts stays sober every night.
  • A female point of contact for every woman in the crew.
  • Our cars only. Nobody rides back alone at night.
  • Drug-free trips. We never provide or support drugs.
  • House parties with permission, outdoor music ending at 10 pm as Goa's rules require.
  • Full terms in writing before you pay a rupee.

Five nights (4–9 Feb) in a luxury villa with a private pool, your Hilltop Festival Weekend 2 pass, a private cook for all meals, house parties and after-parties with booked DJs, cars all trip plus airport pickup and drop, a photographer, the Mooncrew welcome kit, and both hosts the whole time.

Yes. Many of our guests come for their first time. We brief you before the trip, you are never on your own, and one of us stays sober every night.

Yes, and plenty of people do. The crew meets in a WhatsApp group before the trip, and we match room partners. Want a private room? Ask us, and we'll confirm availability and the extra cost.

In Anjuna, Vagator or Assagao, 10 to 15 minutes from Hilltop. We share the exact villa with confirmed guests.

No. Fly or take the train to Goa yourself. We pick you up from Mopa or Dabolim airport on 4 February and drop you back on 9 February.

Festivals in Goa can be stopped at short notice. If that happens, you get back whatever the organiser refunds for your pass, and the villa, food, house parties and the rest of the trip go ahead.
